Folks — forwarding Helix's ask. Key constraints: 15TB/month ingest for pilot, 20k QPS tracing peaks, prefers a concise 1-pager + SOW.

My proposal outline:
- Offer an "Advanced Insights Pack" pilot: 60-day pilot with 50% off observability add-ons (retention + tracing + dashboards) up to an agreed usage cap; include one integration engagement day.
- For committed pricing, propose a "slope" discount: 10% off list for 12-mo commit, 18% for 24-mo, 25% for 36-mo — discounts scale by committed TB and trace QPS.
- Separate tracing meter: tracing billed by sampled-span-unit with a baseline included in pack; overflow billed at per-span rate.

Ben — can you draft an initial quote + spreadsheet covering the pilot cap and three commit scenarios?
Laura — legal: any standard SOW caveats for pilot credits we should pre-clear?
Kimberly — pricing exceptions if they ask for deeper discount to convert pilot?

Thanks,

Got it. Draft quote attached (Pricing model spreadsheet + PDF). High-level notes:

1) Pilot pack (60 days):
   - Observability Advanced Insights Pack: includes 1TB/day retention allowance (approx 30TB/month cap) — pilot discount: 50% off list for up to 15TB/month use; overage at 60% of list.
   - Tracing: sample-rate up to 20k QPS covered during pilot, billable above that.
   - One integration day (engineer) included; additional days at standard rate.

2) Commit scenarios (annualized):
   - 12-mo commit: base 10% off list for the bundle; additional tiered volume discount at +5% when committed TB > 200TB/month aggregated across eval period.
   - 24-mo commit: base 18% off list; additional +7% for volume thresholds.
   - 36-mo commit: base 25% off list; volume trigger adds +10%.

3) Discount "slope" mechanics: discounts prorate with usage; if they hit an overage threshold we credit against subsequent invoices. We included a convert-to-Dedicated credit for multi-year deals (helps tight latency customers).

4) Legal/ops notes: pilot credits apply only to hosted usage; Private deployments require separate commercial carve-outs.

Attached: Helix-Quote-Advanced-Insights-20261031.pdf, pricing-model-breakdown.xlsx, pilot-sow-helix-20261031.docx

If they push for deeper ceilings (30–40% off for 36-mo), we should tie that to a 3-year commit + minimum spend and include SLA uplift. Kimberly, flag exceptions?

—Ben
Principal GTM Strategy — Redwood Inference
